description: Solana balance lookup: native SOL in lamports, optionally plus one SPL token balance (pass the mint, e.g. USDC EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v). Data source: external Solana JSON-RPC (no self-hosted Solana node). Returns: lamports, sol, current slot, and token balance/accounts when a mint is given. Free: no metering.

mint.description: Optional SPL token mint to read

name: sol_get_balance
